set.body:
Do not interpret real-data accuracy until the production pipeline has a directional-derivative and known-transform oracle.

Acceptance gate:
- Test three layers separately: CC intensity derivative; near-identity warp derivative using direct id +/- epsilon*u/2; and the production integrated advance through half-flow, map composition, native pull, work-space gradients, frozen support, and CC.
- Central finite differences over an epsilon ladder show decreasing relative error across at least two successive epsilon values before roundoff. The production integrated pipeline reaches <= 5e-3 relative error on smooth directions in its convergence region.
- Pure translation verifies sign, the factor 1/2, physical-coordinate scaling, and absence of accidental quarter steps.
- Cover identity and nonidentity accumulated maps, image and mask boundaries, anisotropic and oblique grids, every pyramid level, and swapped fixed/moving inputs.
- Synthetic smooth diffeomorphisms at about 2, 4, 8, and 12 mm characterize capture. The 2 and 4 mm cases must reduce endpoint RMS displacement error by at least 80%, improve the registered CC objective, and retain zero sampled det-J <= 0; 8 and 12 mm are reported even if they expose the need for a coarse proposal.
- Every admitted result either satisfies the configured export-inverse tolerance or returns the expected typed failure.
- Failures produce a compact diagnostic receipt that separates metric, sampling, topology, integration, support, and inversion causes.
set.title: HalfFlow-CC G4: end-to-end derivative and synthetic capture admission
